acceptance: Red test first: a profile whose settings_scope, permission_mode or another enum param holds a value its manifest does not define fails LoadProfile or the realizer with an error naming the value.
A launch never starts with an unknown enum value silently dropped.
Docs in STE: the bridge package note records the rule.
fix: realizeScalar adds no flag and gives no error for a value absent from the param's values, so a typo such as settings_scope Project boots a clean-boot seat with the full user settings. Reject an unknown enum value at LoadProfile, or return an error from the realizer that fails the launch.
notes: Console route: bridge launch path. Found by the adversarial review of PR #1231 (LOW, pre-existing).
summary: An enum param value that the manifest does not define realizes no flags and no error; a profile typo silently drops the clean-boot settings scope.
title: The realizer fails loudly on a manifest enum value it does not define
